title: Stockfish, But It Takes 31 Pieces Before Checkmating You
summary: TortureFish (iwantcheckmate.com bot, idea by Monodrift): Stockfish that is not allowed to checkmate you while you still have any piece besides the king; whenever its best move is mate it plays the next best non-mating move. Game 1 lost, game 2 won by walking the king into the open and exploiting the mate ban.
rules: Standard chess vs a Stockfish-based bot (player White).
The bot may not deliver checkmate while the player has any non-king piece; it plays its next best move instead (4:35-4:49).
It is not programmed to hunt captures; otherwise normal Stockfish play (4:49).
No stalemate trick: the bot is a normal opponent once the player only has the king (9:59).
